description:
Configure GeoServer's global settings for a production deployment. 

1. Log in to the GeoServer Web Admin Interface at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (Username: admin, Password: Admin123!).
2. Navigate to 'Global' settings.
3. Set the 'Proxy Base URL' to 'https://maps.cityplanning.example.com/geoserver'.
4. Set the 'Number of decimals' to 6.
5. Enable 'Verbose exception reporting'.
6. Ensure the 'Character Set' is 'UTF-8'.
7. Navigate to 'Contact Information' and set the 'Organization' to 'City Planning Department' and the 'Contact Person' to 'GIS Administrator'.
8. Configure the Logging settings: Change the 'Logging Profile' to 'PRODUCTION_LOGGING'.
9. Save all changes.
10. Verify your configuration by checking the WMS GetCapabilities document (Layer Preview -> OpenLayers or direct URL) to ensure the OnlineResource URLs match the new Proxy Base URL.
11. Create a verification report at '/home/ga/global_settings_report.txt' containing exactly these 4 lines:
    - The proxy base URL you set
    - The number of decimals you set
    - The logging profile you selected
    - 'VERIFIED' (if you confirmed the proxy URL in the capabilities document)
